closed_period_reconciliation.constructive_zero_warning: The zero residual is an IDENTITY, not a test. It proves only that the copy step is exact. It proves nothing about whether the revenue figure's source, period, gross/net basis or consolidation scope are right, and it is NOT accuracy evidence.
closed_period_reconciliation.what_would_be_needed_for_a_real_reconcil: an independently built driver decomposition of the same segment whose sum is compared against this disclosed line, with the residual explained by volume/price/FX/scope/timing

accuracy_reasons: F requires the I-12 frozen design (information-time sample, baseline, uncertainty), which does not exist.
